title: Sherpa-UI app definition
description: One app, as JSON: its Contexts, the one it opens on, its nav sections and its Settings pages. Each path is relative to this file. checkApp() checks its names.

default.description: The Context the app opens on: the nav's Home.

contexts.description: Each Context, by the name the URL carries: ?context=<name>.

types.description: The app's types, by id: each a path to its type.v1 file. Registered before a Context opens, so a page that names one (source.type) has its fields' words, and an entity may be of one (plan 960 U2).

entities.description: The app's preset entities, its Custom Nodes among them (the type node): a path to an entities.v3.json, with the types they are of. Read only; the reader's own are kept apart, app-wide.

settings.description: The pages that open OVER a Context, ?settings=<name>, and the one module that runs them.
